reactor_type: UHV chamber with differentially pumped Dycor mass spectrometer and Auger electron spectrometer
evidence: The WF6 reaction at 473 K required approximately 30 seconds to reach completion at 4.2 31027 Torr. The sample was heated from ambient temperature of 298 K to 473 K. Ten AB cycles of W ALD were necessary to bury the molybdenum substrate.
